What

What Commercial Tree Removal Involves

Commercial tree removal is the complete removal of a standing, leaning, or storm-damaged tree on a commercial parcel — but the administrative scope matters as much as the physical work. Commercial accounts need certificates of insurance with additional-insured endorsements, scheduled work windows that don't disrupt tenants or operations, right-of-way coordination with municipal engineering, and standard B2B billing terms. Every commercial job starts with a free on-site walk and a written estimate before you commit.

The distinction that matters: commercial means higher liability stakes (slip-and-fall on debris, parking-lot closure liability, tenant disruption), more sophisticated insurance requirements (additional-insured endorsements, waivers of subrogation), after-hours and weekend windows to minimize disruption, longer payment cycles on Net 30/60, and larger total job scope across multiple trees. Roubic runs owned equipment — Bandit chipper, Husqvarna saws, and crane-assist only when structural rigging demands it.

How

Roubic's 4-Step Commercial Process

Every job starts with a free on-site walk. Four steps from your first call to job complete. Full 8-step process on the Tree Removal hub.

1

Site Assessment

Aaron or a lead arborist walks the property and access route. Documents condition, structure proximity, and risk.

2

Method Selection

We pick the approach that fits — felling, sectional dismantle, rigging, or crane-assist. No default to the priciest option.

3

Work + Cleanup

Performed to ANSI A300 standards. Brush chipped, wood rounded, ground raked clean. No debris left behind.

4

Final Walk

Aaron or the lead arborist walks the site with you to confirm it's clean. Itemized invoice emailed priority.

Common Commercial Questions

Commercial Tree Removal FAQ

Five things NE Ohio property managers want to know before booking.

Does Roubic provide certificates of insurance for commercial accounts?
Yes — full certificates of insurance with additional-insured endorsements and waiver of subrogation are available on request. Our standard COI satisfies most commercial property management requirements; specific endorsement requests are accommodated case by case.
Can Roubic schedule work outside business hours for commercial accounts?
Yes — after-hours and weekend scheduling is available with no premium for routine work. Emergency response is available 24/7. Most commercial customers schedule work during early-morning or weekend windows to minimize tenant or operational disruption.
What payment terms does Roubic offer for commercial accounts?
Net 30 is standard; Net 60 is available case by case for established accounts. Retainer arrangements for pre-scheduled emergency response are available for time-sensitive operations such as medical campuses, industrial facilities, and multi-tenant retail.
Can Roubic handle multi-property property management contracts?
Yes. Multi-property service contracts spanning multiple commercial parcels are a Roubic specialty. Pricing typically improves on a per-property basis with consolidated scheduling and dispatch.
Does Roubic work as a subcontractor for landscape and property management firms?
Yes — several area landscape and property management firms use Roubic as their tree-service subcontractor for after-hours emergency work, large-tree removal, and crane-assisted projects outside their normal scope. Documented example: a 9 p.m. dispatch for Impullitti Landscaping during a 2024 multi-tree storm event in Pepper Pike.
